Every game suddenly filled with bots
They all follow the same naming conventions, spam emotes and feed constantly, even spamming emotes like 'stun now' and 'push' while dead and clearly with no context.

I've been noticing this getting out of hand over the last several days. Today, most of my matches had bots, one of my matches even had 3 of them on one team.

We report them every time but it doesn't seem to matter and it waste 20-40 minutes of everyone's time while we wait for one of them teams to quickly steam roll the match and end it so we can try to re queue for a game against actual humans.

Is anyone else seeing this mess?
